theme.description: Premium industrial modernism. Clean, engineered, and authoritative. Sharp edges, technical mono accents, and high-contrast photography.

rules: Never use pure black or pure white. Always tint neutrals with Navy.
Use Premium Red (#E11D2E) ONLY for hover states, key kinetic triggers, or tiny technical accents.
Gold (#D4AF37) is for awards, star ratings, or premium highlights.
Buttons must be sharp and rectangular. No pill shapes. Primary button: Navy bg, white text. Hover: Red bg.
Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and tight leading (leading-none).
Overlines and small labels MUST be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]), and use IBM Plex Mono.
DO NOT exceed text-6xl for the largest headings.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #0B1F3A (Light) or #FFFFFF20 (Dark). Use harsh lines to define grids.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use flat design or sharp 8px offset shadows instead of soft blurs.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay on dark mode backgrounds. Images should feel spotlighted or treated.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero overlay MUST NOT exceed bg-black/50. Prefer gradient overlays to maintain image visibility.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Services and Projects. Asymmetry creates tension. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 for hero elements.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and headings. Avoid center-everything.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: use `@studio-freight/lenis` for momentum scrolling. Standard scrolling is forbidden.
motion.hero: MANDATORY: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion.
motion.interactions: Sharp scale-up on image hover. Arrow icons translate-x-1 on hover.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow, organic 'Editorial Ribbon' style separating Hero and About sections.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero image and project images using framer-motion useScroll.

sections.Header: Fixed/Sticky. Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or dark equivalent). Logo left, links center, Theme Toggle + Contact CTA right. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background.
sections.Hero: Full height (min-h-[90vh]). Large kinetic text 'Engineering Excellence That Moves Industries'. Subheading left-aligned. Buttons 'Get Quote' and 'Contact on WhatsApp'. Background image with subtle parallax and mask overlay.
sections.Marquee: Slow moving list of capabilities/values. Monospace font, wide tracking.
sections.AboutUs: Numbered manifesto chapters. Grid layout. '01 Our Vision', '02 The Engineering Edge', '03 Safety Protocol'. Large numerals, sharp text.
sections.Services: 4 Bento Grid Cards. Industrial Relocation, Mechanical, Electrical, Logistics. High contrast images inside cards, 1px border. Sharp hover zoom.
sections.Projects: Capabilities grid. Large high-res imagery. Hover reveals project type and a red/gold accent arrow.
sections.WhyChooseUs: Technical Spec Sheet look. Left side large sticky heading. Right side list of features with IBM Plex Mono numbering and crisp descriptions.
sections.Contact: Two columns. Left: Contact form (Shadcn Input/Textarea/Button). Right: Google Map embed + Address details + WhatsApp CTA.
sections.Footer: Massive 'FURTHMAC' text. 4 columns. Dark background even in light mode for strong contrast shift.

component_instructions.buttons: Custom HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout, but Shadcn Button for forms. Sharp corners, bold text.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Textarea, Form. Customize to remove Vercel soft-shadow look. Use 1px sharp borders.
component_instructions.tech_stack: React JS (.js/.jsx files NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.

images.description: Large industrial machinery factory interior. Darken with overlay for text contrast.
Engineer portrait for the About/Team manifesto section.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for the Header.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use sharp rectangular modern button styles. No pill shapes for this industrial brand.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure the hero text reveal is masked line-by-line, typical of high-end Awwwards sites.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Contact form must have a mailto action or basic submit handling.
Embed a real Google Map iframe for the address.
Share the guideline implementation in .js files since the project does not use TypeScript.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use dark gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the kinetic hero and lenis scroll.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on form inputs and buttons (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2).
